human_tolerance.notes: Reed-bed specialist: found almost exclusively in reed beds, usually with some bushes, and also in damp scrub (Wikipedia).

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: Spanish breeding season; males return from Africa before females; first eggs are laid from late April (Wikipedia). Mark-recapture data for Catalonia and El Hondo list the species as a migrant.

phases.name: absent
phases.note: Migrants winter in sub-Saharan Africa (Wikipedia). Resident Iberian birds (subspecies ambiguus) are not represented; see the PR notes.

vocalizations.description: Slow, chattering song with whistles and mimicry (Wikipedia).
Alarm call when disturbed. Not verified against a recording in this PR (see provenance).

external.note: iNaturalist id 204455 checked at the iNaturalist API (active species, Acrocephalus scirpaceus) and in Wikidata P3151; GBIF usageKey 2493118 checked directly.

common_names.note: en from the Wikipedia title; de and fr from Wikidata labels; nl 'kleine karekiet' from Wikidata.

conservation.note: Wikidata P141 = Q211005 (IUCN Least Concern). Not checked on the IUCN site.

range.note: Native status: ES, FR, NL, GB are the countries of the Eurasian reed-warbler mark-recapture rows in the Scholer dataset (breeding populations under study); Wikipedia says it breeds across Europe. Other European breeding countries are not listed.

traits.limb_count.note: Bird with two legs; wings are not counted (schema convention).

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Hop and Fly are the modes the shared perching-songbird program executes. Climbing among reed stems is common but has no pose and is not modelled.

traits.thermoregulation.note: Bird (endotherm); general bird biology not stated in the Wikipedia extract checked.

traits.skin.note: Feathers; general bird biology, not stated in the extract checked.

traits.nest_type.note: Deep cylindrical cup nest built by the female over water in reeds.

traits.perching.note: Passerine songbird; perches in reeds and bushes.

traits.mass_kg.note: 12.3 g in both the Scholer 'mass' column (CSV row 419) and EltonTraits BodyMass-Value (Dunning08). Mass range omitted: no range source checked.

traits.diet.note: EltonTraits Diet-Inv 70 -> invertebrate 0.7; Diet-Fruit 10 + Diet-PlantO 10 -> fruit 0.2 (schema has no other-plant key; derived); Diet-Seed 10 -> seed 0.1. Wikipedia: insectivorous, occasionally plant material such as berries.

traits.social.note: Usually monogamous (Wikipedia: pairs in breeding). Structure Pair, group size 1-2; judgement from the pair bond.

traits.activity_pattern.note: EltonTraits Nocturnal = 0. Night song is not modelled by the program.

traits.defense.note: Judgement: passerine that escapes by flight to cover.

traits.wariness.note: Judgement, not sourced. Set moderate, between the robin (0.2) and a more skulking warbler.

habitat.use.note: EltonTraits ForStrat ground 20, understory 80, mapped to ground 0.2 and arboreal 0.8. Mapping 'understory' to arboreal is a judgement.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Reed beds 'usually with some bushes' and damp scrub; shrub_thicket is the closest shared tag.

habitat.resources.note: Nest over water in reeds: water/Nesting. Weights are judgement.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Reed-bed specialist (Wikipedia). Urban affinity Avoider is a judgement.

seasonal.strategy.note: Migrant: Wikipedia says it winters in sub-Saharan Africa; Scholer rows list the Eurasian reed-warbler sites as 'migrant'.

seasonal.phases.note: Breeding 04-01 to 08-31 in ES: first eggs late April (Wikipedia), GBIF Apr-Aug high. Absent 11-01 to 02-28 in ES: GBIF Nov 877, Dec 69, Jan 47, Feb 103 records against 40645 in May, so the window is derived from the monthly counts. Resident Iberian birds are not represented.

seasonal.life_stages.note: Judgement: juvenile duration copied from the migrant example archilochus-alexandri; not sourced for this species.

behavior.note: Shared program bt-perching-songbird-v1. Gaits hop and fly; food invertebrate; nest months {4,5,6} via nest_m1=4, nest_m2=6, so July second broods are not modelled.

look.note: Authored block model colours from Wikipedia's description (brown back, buff underparts, pointed bill); proportions judgement.

activity.ES.note: Curve built by tools/fetch_activity.py, method mean(inat_share, gbif_share). GBIF tier A (CC0/CC BY) total 178615. iNaturalist tier A (cc0,cc-by) total 165 and tier B 167, below the 300 threshold; tier C (adds CC BY-NC) total 1020 was used, so the iNaturalist half is NC-licensed (see PR).

vocalizations.song.note: Wikipedia: song is a slow, chattering jit-jit-jit with acrocephaline whistles and mimicry. Season and time windows are judgement.

vocalizations.alarm.note: Judgement: the alarm call is required by the shared program; no recording or alarm-call description was checked for this species. Replace with a sourced description before relying on it.
